'''Veshin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Veshin served the [[Wyrd]], a group of Tarasin [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]], as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. She was the personal bodyguard of the Wyrd sister [[Baeshana]].

{{RPG}}
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Veshin was present on Cularin in the central hut of the village where the [[Zhadorii irstat]] lived, when she and Baeshana were attacked by the [[heroes of Cularin]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Hunting the Wyrd]]'' the identity of the Wyrd sister and bodyguard that the player characters fight in the central hut varies, depending on player level. Upper-level players fight Baeshana and Veshin, but Mid-Level players fight [[Naelora]] and [[Kosaa]] instead, while High-Level players face [[Torunin]] and [[Savina]]. It is also possible for the players to avoid the hut, so even Upper-Level players don't have to fight Baeshana and Veshin.
